title: 第一卷 第7章 怎么可以赶她走第一卷 第8章 我羡慕她羡慕得发疯
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
苏明月感觉自己的心跳快要从嗓子眼蹦出来了。
怎么办怎么办怎么办……
她不想失去现在的一切。她好不容易才摆脱那个糟烂的身份——那个凡间孤女，那个从青楼里被丢出来的没人要的小孩子苏明月。
她好不容易才成为众星捧月的“洛还真”，被师尊宠着，被师兄们捧着，被整个宗门小心翼翼地护着。
她不能失去这些。
绝不能。
面对雷子越探究和怀疑的眼神，苏明月的脑子里一片空白，然后她做了唯一能想到的事——两眼一闭，直接昏了过去。
洛还真偏了偏小脑袋，眨巴眨巴眼睛，望着突然“昏迷”的柔弱大姐姐。
她的气息还带着局促和惶恐呢。
遇到难回答的问题就装昏迷，可是装得一点都不像，相信她的人一定是全世界最大的笨蛋！
“真真！！！”
雷子越一声大吼，抱起苏明月，眨眼功夫便消失不见。
洛还真望着那道远去的焦急背影，嘴巴张成了一个小小的圆形，好半天没合拢。
真的有人相信了。
那个人是本尊的蠢货二师兄！
洛还真小揪揪上插着的小旗子被门外掠入的风吹得直晃悠，像是在和她一起叹气。
浑身伤痕累累的小娃娃气鼓鼓地爬回床上，然后一头拱进被子里，把自己从头到脚蒙了起来。
被子鼓起一个小小的包。
小包一动不动了好一会儿，然后慢慢地、慢慢地缩了缩。
洛还真不开心。

她明明揭穿了那个柔弱大姐姐的真面目，证明了自己才是真正的真真了。
为什么二师兄还是抱着那个假货走了？
……
丹峰大殿。
身穿绿色宫裙的中年女修坐在医榻旁，用湿帕子轻轻擦拭榻上少女额间的细汗。
她动作温柔，抬眼看向跪在面前的雷子越时，目光却冷得像腊月的寒潭。
“许是情绪起伏过度，陷入昏迷了，无甚大碍。”
丹红长老将帕子搁回铜盆，声音不大，却字字带着刺，“不过倒是子越你怎么回事？前几日带她出去玩，受了惊吓；昨日任由她胡闹陪她去监督新弟子试炼，被那鲁莽小外门伤到。没消停一宿，今日又出事！你明知她身体不好，受不得刺激……”
雷子越跪在蒲团上，一声不吭地挨骂，他的眼睛盯着地面，但眼神是散的，满脑子都是刚才那个小豆丁的模样。
满脸的疤，浑身的伤，枯草一样的头发扎着两个歪歪扭扭的小揪揪。
可是那双眼睛——那双又大又亮的眼睛，倔强又干净，和真真小时候一模一样。
她说，她才是真真。
content_en:
Su Mingyue felt that her heartbeat was about to jump out of her throat.
What to do, what to do, what to do...
She doesn't want to lose everything she has now. It took a lot of effort for her to get rid of that bad identity - that orphan girl in the world, that unwanted child Su Mingyue who was thrown out of the brothel.
She finally became the "Luo Huanzhen" who was admired by all the stars. She was pampered by her master, held up by her senior brothers, and carefully protected by the entire sect.
She can't lose these.
Absolutely not.
Facing Lei Zi's increasingly probing and suspicious eyes, Su Mingyue's mind went blank, and then she did the only thing she could think of - she closed her eyes and passed out.
Luo turned his little head to the side, blinked his eyes, and looked at the frail elder sister who suddenly "came into a coma".
Her breath was still filled with embarrassment and fear.
She pretends to be comatose when faced with difficult questions, but she doesn't look like one at all. Anyone who believes her must be the biggest fool in the world!
"Really!!!"
Lei Ziyue roared loudly, picked up Su Mingyue, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Luo Huazhen looked at the anxious figure walking away, his mouth opened into a small circle, and he didn't close it for a long time.
Someone actually believed it.
That person is my stupid second senior brother!
The little flag on Luo Huanzhen's little shirt was swaying by the wind blowing in from outside the door, as if he was sighing with her.
The scarred little baby crawled back onto the bed angrily, then dove into the quilt and covered himself from head to toe.
There was a small bulge in the quilt.
Xiaobao remained motionless for a while, and then slowly, slowly shrank.
Luo was really unhappy.
She clearly exposed the true face of that weak elder sister and proved that she is truly Zhenzhen.
Why did the second senior brother still hold the fake and leave?
…
Danfeng Hall.
A middle-aged female cultivator wearing a green palace dress sat beside the hospital bed, gently wiping the sweat from the girl's forehead with a wet handkerchief.
She moved gently, and when she raised her eyes to look at Lei Ziyue who was kneeling in front of her, her eyes were as cold as the cold pool of the twelfth lunar month.
"Maybe he had excessive mood swings and fell into a coma. It's nothing serious."
Elder Danhong put the handkerchief back into the copper basin, his voice was low, but his words were thorny, "But Ziyue, what's the matter with you? I took her out to play a few days ago and was frightened. Yesterday, I allowed her to go wild and accompany her to supervise the new disciples' trial, and was injured by the reckless little outsider. I didn't stay overnight, and something happened again today! You knew that she was not in good health and couldn't bear the stimulation..."
Lei Ziyue knelt on the futon and was scolded without saying a word. His eyes were staring at the ground, but his eyes were distracted, and his mind was filled with the appearance of the little bean sprout just now.
His face is covered with scars, his body is covered with injuries, and his hair like withered grass is tied up in two crooked little knots.
But those eyes - those big, bright eyes, stubborn and clean, exactly the same as when Zhenzhen was a child.
She said that she is the real one.
